prs.title: read-cache: avoid sparse-index expansion on unborn branches
prs.summary: Eliminates unnecessary sparse-index expansion on unborn branches by comparing the index against the empty tree instead of falling back to a full index walk. Added test coverage for nested directory paths without performance degradation.

prs.title: wt-status: avoid quadratic insertion for untracked paths
prs.summary: Reduced status untracked path collection from O(n^2) to O(n log n) by replacing repeated sorted insertions with a single append-and-sort pass.

prs.title: [PATCH] pack-redundant: fix memory leak when open_pack_index() fails
prs.summary: Fixes a memory leak in add_pack() when open_pack_index() fails.
